name: underlings
author: TheNightProject
description: Underlings: the page, worker and app, and the review engine they run, in one repo.

scripts.setup: npm --prefix engine install && npm --prefix desktop install
scripts.app: npm run setup && npm --prefix desktop run install-app
scripts.build: npm --prefix engine run build && node scripts/stamp.mjs
scripts.test: npm run test:engine && npm run test:cc
scripts.test:cc: npm run build && TZ=Europe/London LC_ALL=en_US.UTF-8 node --experimental-test-module-mocks --test --test-concurrency=4 "**/*.test.mjs"
scripts.test:golden: npm run build && TZ=Europe/London LC_ALL=en_US.UTF-8 node --experimental-test-module-mocks --test lib/gitlab-golden.test.mjs lib/gitlab-golden-github.test.mjs
